## Crossref documentation

- Crossref API: <https://api.crossref.org/>
- Crossref’s API issue tracker:
  <https://crossref.atlassian.net/jira/software/c/projects/CR/issues/>
- Crossref metadata search API: <https://search.crossref.org/>
- Crossref DOI Content Negotiation:
  <https://www.crossref.org/documentation/retrieve-metadata/content-negotiation/>
- Crossref Text and Data Mining (TDM) Services:
  www.crossref.org/documentation/retrieve-metadata/rest-api/text-and-data-mining/

## Installation

Stable version from CRAN

``` r

install.packages("rcrossref")
```

Or development version from GitHub

``` r

remotes::install_github("ropensci/rcrossref")
```

Load `rcrossref`

``` r

library('rcrossref')
```

## Register for the Polite Pool

If you are intending to access Crossref regularly you will want to send
your email address with your queries. This has the advantage that
queries are placed in the polite pool of servers. Including your email
address is good practice as described in the Crossref documentation
(<https://api.crossref.org/swagger-ui/index.html#access>). The second
advantage is that Crossref can contact you if there is a problem with a
query.

Details on how to register your email in a call can be found at
`?rcrossref-package`. To pass your email address to Crossref, simply
store it as an environment variable in .Renviron like this:

Open file: `file.edit("~/.Renviron")`

Add email address to be shared with Crossref
`crossref_email= "name@example.com"`

Save the file and restart your R session

To stop sharing your email when using rcrossref simply delete it from
your .Renviron file.

## Documentation

See <https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/> to get started

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cr_abstract()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_abstract.md)
  : Get abstract
- [`cr_agency()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_agency.md)
  : Check the DOI minting agency on one or more dois
- [`cr_citation_count()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_citation_count.md)
  : Get a citation count via CrossRef OpenURL
- [`cr_cn()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_cn.md) :
  Get citations in various formats from CrossRef.
- [`cr_funders()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_funders.md)
  [`cr_funders_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_funders.md)
  : Search the CrossRef Fundref API
- [`cr_journals()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_journals.md)
  [`cr_journals_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_journals.md)
  : Search CrossRef journals
- [`cr_licenses()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_licenses.md)
  [`cr_licenses_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_licenses.md)
  : Search CrossRef licenses
- [`cr_members()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_members.md)
  [`cr_members_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_members.md)
  : Search CrossRef members
- [`cr_prefixes()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_prefixes.md)
  [`cr_prefixes_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_prefixes.md)
  : Search CrossRef prefixes
- [`cr_r()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_r.md) :
  Get a random set of DOI's through CrossRef.
- [`cr_types()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_types.md)
  [`cr_types_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_types.md)
  : Search CrossRef types
- [`cr_works()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_works.md)
  [`cr_works_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/cr_works.md)
  : Search CrossRef works (articles)
- [`filter_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/filters.md)
  [`filter_details()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/filters.md)
  : Get filter details and names.
- [`get_styles()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/get_styles.md)
  : Get list of styles from github.com/citation-style-language/styles
- [`id_converter()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/id_converter.md)
  : Get a PMID from a DOI, and vice versa.
- [`rcrossref-defunct`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/rcrossref-defunct.md)
  : Defunct functions in rcrossref
- [`rcrossref-deprecated`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/rcrossref-deprecated.md)
  : Deprecated functions in rcrossref
- [`rcrossref-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/rcrossref-package.md)
  [`rcrossref`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rcrossref/reference/rcrossref-package.md)
  : rcrossref
